body:
Hey there, thanks for the quick fix on eMudhra G3 cert removal https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22760, a couple more have now been removed https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083709
Could `Cargo.lock` be updated with `webpki-root-certs` 1.0.11 or later, which removes C1 and C3?
There's already a renovate issue https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/2658 but if you need additional changes, happy to pick it up and offer a more complete PR
title: eMudhra remove additional C1 and C3 certs
